# Products

ZUGEE makes 11 products a business can use today. Each is separate software with its own login and data. For a general business that is not in a listed industry, ZUGEE Omni covers customers, sales, billing, payments and stock (see also the FAQ on unlisted industries).

## ZUGEE Omni (id: core-erp)
Page: /erp-crm-software (https://www.getzugee.com/erp-crm-software)
Category: Business Platform. Tailored for: Any business. Replaces: Excel + WhatsApp + standalone Tally.
What it does: Customers, leads, products, sales, billing, payments and inventory for a general business.
Key capabilities (modules): Customers, Leads, Products, Sales & billing, Payments, Inventory
CAN'T CONFIRM for ZUGEE Omni (do not claim these; other products' pages describe them): Part payments / instalments
Overview: ZUGEE Omni brings your leads, customers, products, sales bills, payments and stock into one system, so the business stops living across Excel sheets, WhatsApp chats and a Tally computer only one person can use. Our team sets it up for you in 14 days, moves your customer and item lists across and trains your staff.
Features:
- CRM for small business, without the complexity: Record every enquiry from a walk-in, a phone call or a reference as a lead. Note what they asked for, set the next follow-up, and turn the lead into a customer when they buy. A distributor with three salespeople sees every open enquiry in one list instead of three phones.
- Customer records that stay with the company: Each customer has one record with their contact details, past bills and payments. When a salesperson leaves, the customer history stays in ZUGEE Omni instead of walking out in their phone.
- GST billing software for daily sales: Make sales bills from your product list with the right price and tax on each line. The bill goes into the customer's account at once, so nobody types it again in another register.
- Billing and inventory software in one place: Keep your products with their units and prices, and see the stock on hand. Because billing and stock are the same system, a sale and its stock movement never drift apart. Opening stock goes in during setup, so you start with real numbers on the first day.
- Payments and outstanding by customer: Record cash, UPI, cheque or bank transfer against the bills they settle. Check who owes what before you give more credit to a regular customer. Part payments are normal in Indian trade, so one bill can be settled over several payments.
- A Tally alternative for daily operations: Run day-to-day selling, billing and collections in ZUGEE Omni, and let your accountant keep Tally for returns and audits. We export the data they need, so the two never fight each other. Daily work stays in one place your team can use, while statutory work stays where it already is.
Who it is for: Traders, Distributors, Wholesalers, Retailers, Service businesses, Small manufacturers
Questions and answers:
- Q: What is ERP and CRM software? A: ERP software runs the operational side of a business, such as billing, stock and payments. CRM software looks after the selling side: leads, follow-ups and customer history. ZUGEE Omni puts both in one system built for small businesses in India, so a sale is tracked from the first enquiry to the last payment.
- Q: Is ZUGEE Omni too big for a small business with two or three staff? A: No. ZUGEE Omni is set up around the way you already work, and we switch on only what you use. A shop with one counter and a distributor with a sales team use the same product, sized to their business.
- Q: Can I use ZUGEE Omni on my mobile phone? A: Yes. ZUGEE Omni runs in a web browser, so you can check a customer's balance or the day's sales on an Android phone as well as on the office computer. Each staff member signs in with their own login.
- Q: Does ZUGEE Omni make GST bills, and do I still need Tally? A: ZUGEE Omni makes sales bills with GST for your daily trade. Many businesses keep Tally with their chartered accountant for returns and audits; we export the billing data the accountant needs, so nobody types the same bills twice.
- Q: Can I move my existing customers and items from Excel or Tally? A: Yes. During the 14-day setup our team brings your customer list, item list with prices and opening balances across from Excel or your Tally exports, and goes through them with you before you go live.
- Q: How much does ZUGEE Omni cost? A: The price depends on how many users and branches you have, plus a one-time setup fee for configuration, data migration and training. We give you a clear quote on a short call once we understand your business.

## ZUGEE Fleet (id: transposs)
Page: /fleet-management-software (https://www.getzugee.com/fleet-management-software)
Category: Fleet Management. Tailored for: Fleet & transport. Replaces: Paper logbooks + WhatsApp driver dispatch.
What it does: Manage vehicles, drivers, bookings, trips, maintenance and fleet expenses.
Key capabilities (modules): Vehicles, Drivers, Bookings, Trips, Maintenance, Billing
CAN'T CONFIRM for ZUGEE Fleet (do not claim these; other products' pages describe them): Customer dues, credit sales and outstanding balances; Part payments / instalments; Inventory and stock
Overview: ZUGEE Fleet keeps your vehicles, drivers, bookings, trips, maintenance and billing in one system, so you stop running the fleet from a paper logbook and a dozen WhatsApp groups. Our team sets it up for your business in 14 days, brings your existing records across and trains your office staff.
Features:
- Vehicle records for the whole fleet: Add every truck, tanker, cab or bus once, with its registration number and type. Its trips, maintenance and billing all hang off that one record, so you stop keeping a separate register for each vehicle.
- Driver details and duty in one list: Keep each driver's details in ZUGEE Fleet and see which trips they have run. When a driver leaves, the trip history stays with your company instead of leaving in their phone.
- Transport management software for bookings: Take a booking when the customer calls, then assign a vehicle and a driver to it. Your dispatch desk works from one booking list instead of a notebook, a whiteboard and three phones.
- Trip sheet software instead of paper trip sheets: Each trip has its own digital trip sheet: the booking it belongs to, the vehicle, the driver and the route. No more collecting crumpled sheets from the cabin at the end of the week.
- Vehicle maintenance software with a history: Record every service, repair and part change against the vehicle. Before you send a vehicle on a long run, you can check when it was last serviced and what work was done.
- GST billing for transport customers: Raise bills for completed trips from the trip record, with your business details and your customer's details on the invoice. Your accountant can keep using Tally; we export what they need.
Who it is for: Goods transport & logistics, Truck and tanker owners, Cab operators, Tourist bus operators, School transport
Questions and answers:
- Q: What is fleet management software? A: Fleet management software is one system for running your vehicles: which vehicle and driver go on which trip, what each vehicle needs in maintenance, and what each trip should be billed. ZUGEE Fleet is fleet management software, built for transport businesses in India.
- Q: Is ZUGEE Fleet suitable for a small transport business with only a few vehicles? A: Yes. The problems of a paper logbook start with the second vehicle, not the fiftieth. ZUGEE Fleet is set up around your business, so an owner with a handful of trucks or cabs uses the same bookings, trips, maintenance and billing screens as a larger fleet, without the parts they do not need.
- Q: Can my office staff and supervisors use ZUGEE Fleet on a mobile phone? A: Yes. ZUGEE Fleet runs in a web browser, so staff can open it on an Android phone as well as on the office computer. Each person signs in with their own login and sees only what their role allows.
- Q: Can ZUGEE Fleet make GST bills for transport services? A: Yes. The Billing module raises bills for completed trips with your business and customer details. Your chartered accountant can keep using Tally for returns and audits, and we can export the billing data they need in a format they can work with.
- Q: Does ZUGEE Fleet send trip updates or bills to customers on WhatsApp? A: Not yet. WhatsApp sending is coming soon to ZUGEE products. Today you can share bills and trip details with customers the way you already do, and we will tell you on your demo call when WhatsApp sending is ready.
- Q: How much does ZUGEE Fleet cost? A: It depends on the number of users and branches, plus a one-time setup fee that covers configuration, data migration and training. We share the exact figure on a short call after understanding your fleet, before you decide.
